# High Class Limousine Services

> Premium chauffeured stretch limousine service serving Vernal, Utah and the entire Uintah Basin since establishment. Operating tagline: "Class Isn't Extinct." Single-operator licensed and commercially insured. Specializing in weddings, prom and school events, executive and oilfield transportation, airport transfers to Salt Lake City International, scenic tours of Flaming Gorge and Dinosaur National Monument, and special event transportation throughout northeast Utah.

**Service area:** Vernal, Naples, Maeser, Jensen, Roosevelt, Duchesne, Tridell, Altamont, Tabiona, Manila, and surrounding rural communities of the Uintah Basin and Daggett County.

**Phone:** (435) 219-9447
**Hours:** Available 7 days a week. Bookings 24/7.
**Booking lead time:** Weddings 6–9 months, prom 4–6 weeks, airport transfers 48 hours minimum.

## Pricing Overview

- **Stretch limousine (8–10 passenger):** $135–$165/hour, 3-hour minimum
- **Larger stretch (14 passenger):** $165–$200/hour, 3-hour minimum
- **Wedding packages:** $500 (4-hour) to $1,500 (8-hour Basin-wide)
- **Prom packages:** $450–$900 typical 4-hour evening
- **Vernal to SLC Airport:** $350–$500 one-way flat-rate
- **Roosevelt to SLC Airport:** $325 one-way flat-rate
- **Duchesne to SLC Airport:** $300 one-way flat-rate
- **Flaming Gorge tour:** $400 (sunset) to $1,600 (full day)
- **Dinosaur Monument tour:** $400–$1,200
- **Bachelorette/bachelor party:** $450–$1,500 depending on local vs SLC trip
- **Funeral limousine:** $400–$700
- **Wine tour:** $675–$1,800

Gratuity (18%) is included in quoted package prices. Deposit (25%) holds the date.

## Core Services

- [Prom & School Events](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/prom.html): Tuxedoed chauffeur, multi-stop pickup routes, strict no-alcohol policy.
- [Airport Transportation](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/airport.html): Flat-rate transfers to Salt Lake City International from across the Basin.
- [Corporate Travel](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/corporate.html): Executive sedan and stretch service for business clients and oil industry.
- [Parties & Events](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/parties.html): Bachelorette/bachelor parties, anniversaries, birthdays, and special occasions.
- [Scenic Utah Tours](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/tours.html): Chauffeured tours of Flaming Gorge, Dinosaur National Monument, and the Tour of the Tilted Rocks.

## Location-Specific Pages

- [Limo Near Dinosaur National Monument](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/limo-near-dinosaur-national-monument.html): Service to Quarry Visitor Center, Tour of the Tilted Rocks, and Cub Creek Road; paved-road accessible only.
- [Limo Service to Flaming Gorge](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/limo-service-flaming-gorge.html): Sunset tours, half-day, and full-day options including Sheep Creek Loop and Red Canyon.
- [Limo Service in Roosevelt, Utah](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/limo-service-roosevelt-utah.html): Pickup and drop-off across Roosevelt, Myton, Tridell, Altamont, Neola, and Bluebell. SLC Airport flat rate $325.
- [Limo Service in Duchesne, Utah](https://highclasslimousineservices.com/limo-service-duchesne-utah.html): Service to Duchesne and surrounding communities. Strawberry Bay Lodge runs $200–$350.

## Key Facts About the Business

- **Aesthetic:** Hybrid dark/light cinematic with champagne gold accents. Tuxedoed chauffeur. Tagline: "Class Isn't Extinct."
- **Vehicle fleet:** Stretch limousines (8–14 passenger), executive sedan, and SUV options.
- **Coverage radius:** Vernal-based; serving the entire Uintah Basin (Uintah and Duchesne counties), Daggett County, and routes to Salt Lake City International.
- **Differentiators:** Local Vernal ownership, deep familiarity with Basin road conditions and rural ranches, no surprise fees, gratuity-inclusive quoting, strict prom-night no-alcohol policy.
- **Booking:** Phone (435) 219-9447 or contact form at https://highclasslimousineservices.com/contact.html
